title: Twelve years
logline: Twelve. The corn. The strip is in three newspapers and Wood eats corn at a drafting table in a garage exactly as before.

panels.composition: The garage. Corn. Three newspapers on the table, each open to the strip: Newport, Florence, Lincoln City. WOOD. BARNABY, ten.

image.prompt: a man at a drafting table with a tray of corn and three different local newspapers each open to the same comic strip, an old dog under the table, muddy flats

panels.composition: The three strips side by side. Same strip. Three dot gains. Wood comparing them like a man checking his own face in three mirrors.

image.prompt: close-up of the same comic strip printed in three different newspapers side by side, the ink slightly different in each, a man's hands holding them

balloons.text: Twelve years. Three papers. Florence prints me darker. I prefer Florence.

image.prompt: a man talking to an old dog about newsprint, fond

panels.composition: Alone at the long surface. Three papers. Corn. Dog. #1.

image.prompt: a man with his back turned at a long drafting table covered in newspapers, a tray of corn, an old dog, a yellowed strip on the wall, no words
